title: The Final Arrangement
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, the last page of the Tianji Record quietly revealed a line of blood text—'Chapter 1155, you will face the final trial.' The ink seemed to have just seeped from the depths of fate, carrying an indescribable chill, heralding that a greater storm was brewing.

text.content: As the light of the Axis of Fate gradually faded, Chen Nian's figure grew clearer. She was no longer that little girl with double buns who used to chase after her brother begging for sweets—ten thousand years of vicissitudes had carved her brows and eyes like an ice sculpture, yet only when gazing at Chen Ji would a flicker of mortal warmth appear in those eyes. 'Brother,' her voice was gentle, as if afraid to disturb anything, 'This time, let me protect you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian...

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, yet an invisible barrier blocked him. The rules of the Axis of Fate were so cruel—once he made his choice, there was no turning back. His sister, who had haunted his thoughts through countless epochs, was now close yet impossibly far. He could see the tear凝结 at the corner of her eye, the bitter smile on her lips, but could never again touch her warm, soft hand.

dialogue.content: 'Don't linger for my sake,' Chen Nian's form began to fade. 'The people of Tianqing Sect are still waiting for you—Su Qingyao... she has waited for you far too long. Go, brother. This time, let me do one last thing for you—I will become the nourishment for this Axis of Fate, merging all my Heavenly Fate power into it. This way, you will have enough strength...' Her voice hitched. '...to protect the ones you want to protect.'

text.content: No! Chen Ji wanted to scream, yet found himself unable to produce any sound. He could only watch helplessly as Chen Nian's form completely merged into the radiance of the Axis of Fate, transforming into a gentle force that surged into his body. It was his sister's final Heavenly Fate, all the painstaking effort from her ten thousand years of lonely vigil. Warm and familiar, yet it left Chen Ji feeling more suffocated than ever before.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji!'

text.content: A sharp sword light tore through the Void, and Su Qingyao's figure shot out from the transmission formation. She wore a plain white long dress today, her robes fluttering with the inherent restraint and dignity unique to an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect. Yet when she clearly saw the scene before her, those typically cold eyes suddenly reddened—she saw the two silent streams of tears sliding down Chen Ji's face, saw the Axis of Fate devouring the last traces of Chen Nian's light.

dialogue.content: 'She left again...' Su Qingyao's voice was soft, soft like a petal falling on Chen Ji's shoulder. She didn't ask who Chen Nian was, didn't ask what had happened, only stood quietly beside him, letting her sleeve gently brush against his hand. For ten thousand years, she understood this man too well—he knew all the answers yet never spoke them lightly. He concealed all his sorrow in the deepest corners of his heart, only licking his wounds alone in solitude.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, his gaze falling on Su Qingyao's face. This woman, from the cold Inner Disciple Senior Fellow she once was, to the beloved willing to block swords and arrows for him, had never retreated throughout the journey. Three times she approached the truth, three times she was lost in the elaborate fog he designed, yet she never truly left. 'Qingyao,' his voice was somewhat hoarse, 'This life, let me protect you.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's body stiffened slightly, a trace of disbelief flickering in those clear, cold eyes. She had waited for these words too long, too long—almost believing she would never hear them in this lifetime. Yet when the words truly reached her ears, she only gently shook her head: 'Fool, I never needed your protection. I only want...' Her voice suddenly choked. '...to stand shoulder to shoulder with you.'

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's confession, how should Chen Ji respond to this sincere emotion?

choices.description: Gently grasp Su Qingyao's hand, making a vow to protect each other side by side
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate points to stabilize the Axis of Fate
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Shared Destiny' bond, sharing Heavenly Fate with Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is already scarce—this move may bring backlash

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao felt the warmth spreading through her palm, and the tears in her eyes finally spilled over. She didn't speak, only gripped Chen Ji's hand even tighter, as if wanting to melt ten thousand years of waiting into this single clasp.

text.content: The Axis of Fate, sensing the hearts of both, rippled with a gentle radiance. Chen Ji felt a wondrous resonance form between his Heavenly Fate power and Su Qingyao's—it was the awakening of the 'Shared Destiny' bond. From now on, their fates would intertwine tightly, regardless of life or death.

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶缔结共命羁绊

choices.description: Bury these feelings deep in your heart, waiting until the world is at peace to make promises
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate points, storing strength for the final decisive battle
choices.risk_hint: May cause Su Qingyao to feel disappointed

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's gaze dimmed for a moment, but she quickly gathered her emotions, returning to that cold and proud Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. She gently withdrew her hand and stepped back: "You're right. The greater good comes first. After everything is over..." She didn't finish, only turning to gaze into the distance.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at her lonely figure, a faint ache tugging at his heart. But he didn't chase after her to explain—some words truly can only be spoken once everything has settled like dust.

choices.text: Setting up the board for her
choices.description: Covertly weaving the strongest protection into her fate, ensuring her safety
choices.visible_cost: Consuming 15 Heavenly Fate points to rewrite Su Qingyao's destiny line
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao gains the "Heavenly Fate Shelter" status
choices.risk_hint: Covertly altering another's fate carries inherent risks

text.content: Chen Ji took advantage of Su Qingyao's momentary carelessness, covertly channeling the power of the Tianji Record. A golden thread quietly appeared on her destiny line—this was the protection Chen Ji had planted using his own Heavenly Fate as the seed. As long as she lived, this protection would exist eternally.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly felt a wave of warmth wash over her entire body. She turned to look at Chen Ji, her gaze carrying a hint of confusion: "What did you do?" Chen Ji only smiled faintly, saying nothing. Some secrets, he intended to keep forever buried in his heart.

text.content: However, just at this moment, the Axis of Fate suddenly trembled violently. A cold and sinister aura drifted from the distance—that was Ling Yuan's presence. This old fox truly hadn't given up, choosing this moment to make a desperate counterattack.

choices.memory_label: 为苏青瑶种下天命守护

text.content: The trembling of the Axis of Fate grew increasingly violent, and a ferocious crack tore open in the Void. Ling Yuan's figure slowly walked out from the rift. His face was more withered than before, but those eyes burned with an almost manic obsession. "Chen Ji," his voice cold as the netherworld's bitter wind, "You think you've won? You think possessing the Tianji Record means you can control everything?"

dialogue.content: "Old thing, you still haven't given up?" Chen Ji turned around, his face showing no sign of surprise, as if he had long foreseen this. He stood with hands behind his back, gazing calmly at Ling Yuan, even a faint sneer curling at the corner of his mouth—this expression was just like those senior disciples who had mocked him back in the Servants' Quarters.

text.content: Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with madness: "I've waited too long for this day! Abandoned by the Tianji Record, forgotten by the sect, toyed with by fate... I'm done enduring!" He violently stirred the demonic energy within his body, and the entire Tianqing Sect trembled for it. However, the moment he prepared to strike, a black figure stepped in front of Chen Ji—it was Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saint.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing turned around, looking at Chen Ji, her eyes carrying a complex emotion: "The prophecy you showed me through the Tianji Record back then... I've been waiting for this day." She gently raised her hand, and black demonic mist condensed into an exquisite token in her palm, "This is the Holy Sect's 'Token of Independence.' From now on, the Demonic Holy Sect will no longer be anyone's chess piece."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the token in Ye Qing's hand, a flood of indescribable emotions rising in his heart. The corner of the future he had glimpsed through the Tianji Record was becoming reality. He knew how much Ye Qing had sacrificed for this day—betraying the Holy Sect, renouncing the Demonic Path,独自承担 all the blame and pursuit alone. This seemingly delicate woman had a heart stronger than anyone else's.

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's threats and Ye Qing's independence, how should Chen Ji plan the future world situation?

choices.description: Formally recognize the Holy Sect's independent status, forming a strategic alliance
choices.visible_cost: May provoke dissatisfaction from orthodox sects
choices.visible_reward: Gain comprehensive support from the Demonic Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: The conflict between righteousness and evil has always been sensitive

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes reddened slightly, but she quickly composed herself, returning to that cold Demonic Path Saint. She knelt on one knee, raising the token high above her head: "Ye Qing is willing to follow Young Master Chen, to create a new era!"

text.content: Chen Ji personally helped her rise, placing the token back into her palm: "There's no need to kneel before me. From now on, you and I are equals. This world is too vast for me to guard alone—but if we join hands, perhaps we can see a different landscape."

choices.description: Refuse any association with the Demonic Path, maintaining the image of righteousness
choices.visible_reward: Consolidating the Leader Position of the Righteous Path
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing Might Therefore Fall to Darkness

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression froze instantly, the light in her eyes rapidly dimming. She slowly retracted the token, a self-mocking bitter smile curling at her lips: "So... in your eyes, I am ultimately nothing more than a usable chess piece?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not explain. He knew some choices would inevitably disappoint some people, but this was the price he had to bear. The moment Ye Qing turned and walked away, he felt a slight twinge in his heart—but he still did not call out to stop her.

choices.description: Let Ye Qing First Prove Her Worth, Then Decide Whether to Form an Alliance

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately express his stance, simply casting Ye Qing a profound glance: "While proof of independence is indeed precious, the Holy Sect's pursuit will never cease. Are you certain you can hold on until the very end?" The words were blunt, yet also a unique form of test.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed—that smile carried a hint of determination: "Is Chen Gongzi testing me? Very well, let me show you the backbone of the Demonic Path Saint." She turned to face Ling Yuan, demonic mist churning around her body, "This old creature, leave him to me!"

text.content: Chen Ji watched Ye Qing rush out, a slight curve forming at the corner of his mouth. This answer, he was very satisfied with.

Ye Qing's demonic fog collided violently with Ling Yuan's demonic energy in mid-air, erupting in dazzling light. Seeing this, Su Qingyao acted without hesitation, drawing her sword—the Tianqing Sect's supreme sword technique "Blue Exceeds Green" manifested as a fierce sword intent, directly targeting Ling Yuan's vitals. With the three launching a joint assault, Ling Yuan's disadvantage grew increasingly apparent.

dialogue.content: "Hahaha!" Ling Yuan suddenly erupted into mad laughter, his withered face contorting like a vengeful ghost, "You think this can kill me? How naive!" He bit through his tongue violently, spitting a mouthful of essence blood, "Demonic Blood Art—BURN!"

text.content: Ling Yuan's aura suddenly surged, actually forcing back the three-person combined assault. But Chen Ji remained unruffled—he had long calculated this step. Ling Yuan's trump card was merely a cornered beast's last struggle; burning demonic blood might briefly enhance strength, but would completely sever his vitality. This old creature was destined to die after all.

dialogue.content: "Enough!" A domineering voice rang from the heavens, followed by a golden figure crashing into the battlefield like a meteor—it was Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie. His fighting spirit had become even more fierce, yet his eyes carried a complex emotion. "Chen Ji, I have come to assist you."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at this former nemesis, a playful arc curving at the corner of his mouth. Han Lie had changed—no longer the reckless fool who only knew how to swing fists. His choice to appear at this moment meant he had made his decision. Chen Ji's gaze toward him held a hint of appreciation: "Han Lie, you have come at the perfect time."

choice.prompt: Faced with Han Lie's主动示好, how should Chen Ji handle this relationship that is both foe and potential ally?

choices.description: Put Aside Past Grudges, Incorporate Han Lie into the New Order
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie Has Betrayed Multiple Times

dialogue.content: Han Lie froze momentarily, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's decisiveness. He knelt on one knee, clasping his fist: "Han Lie has greatly offended you before, today I am willing to serve Chen Gongzi with this remaining body!"

text.content: "Chen Ji reached out and helped him up, his tone flat yet carrying an undeniable air of authority: 'Let bygones be bygones. From now on, we share a common enemy—Ling Yuan. You surely know the threat of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.'"

choices.description: "Han Lie has betrayed multiple times and cannot be spared"
choices.visible_cost: "Loss of potential support from Xuanwu Sect"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie's expression shifted abruptly, his gratitude instantly transforming into fury: 'Chen Ji! Don't think I'm afraid of you!' His fists clenched with a grinding sound, his aura surging wildly around him, 'I've roamed the world纵横天下, and when have I ever suffered such humiliation!'"

text.content: "Chen Ji merely glanced at him indifferently, that gaze more humiliating than any mockery. 'You are indeed strong,' he said slowly, 'but every time you've challenged me, haven't you returned defeated? Han Lie, face reality—you were never my match.'"

choices.description: "Accept Han Lie's help but make clear this is him repaying his old debt"

text.content: "Chen Ji nodded slightly, accepting Han Lie's help. But he turned the conversation: 'Han Lie, what you owe me, settle it all today. Though Ling Yuan's Demonic Blood Art is formidable, it has a fatal flaw—he burns his lifespan, not merely demonic qi. As long as we endure a quarter hour, he'll naturally exhaust himself.'"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie gritted his teeth, 'Fine!' He roared, golden light blazing around him as he transformed into a roaring Xuanwu beast, charging toward Ling Yuan. This was his trump card technique—'True Xuanwu Form'!"

text.content: "The four's combined assault finally drove Ling Yuan into a corner. When the last trace of demonic qi within Ling Yuan burned out, he let out an unwilling howl: 'Chen Ji! You've won... but don't celebrate too soon! The Eye of Heavenly Secrets won't let you off!' Before the words finished, his body turned to ashes, completely dissipating into the heavens and earth."

"Ling Yuan had fallen. This once-untouchable former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect ultimately died beneath his own obsession. The battlefield fell into a brief silence, only the wind wailing across the shattered mountains and rivers. Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, walked to Chen Ji's side, and gently took his hand."

dialogue.content: "'It's over.' Her voice was soft, yet carried a relieved ease. Yet Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze profound as he looked toward the distance: 'No, it's only beginning. Ling Yuan was right—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets won't let us off.'"

text.content: "Ye Qing stepped forward, placing the proof of independence into his chest: 'What do we do next?' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly turned, gazing at the Tianji Record that still emanated a faint glow. His eyes were deep as an abyss, as if capable of seeing through the ultimate mysteries of fate."

"At that moment, the Tianji Record suddenly opened its final page on its own. A line of blood-red characters slowly emerged, carrying an indescribable chill—that was a warning from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets: 'Chapter 1155, you will face the final trial.' Chen Ji gazed at those words, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips."

dialogue.content: "'The good show has just begun.' Chen Ji's voice echoed across the empty battlefield, carrying a near-paranoid confidence. He slowly turned, looking at everyone beside him—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Han Lie... these people would all be key pieces in his chess game against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: "The setting sun's afterglow spilled over the ruins, stretching everyone's shadow long and long. Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the power from the Tianji Record within him—that was the power Chen Nian had exchanged his Heavenly Fate for, the power condensed from countless people's trust. From this moment on, he was no longer fighting alone."

dialogue.content: "'Young Master,' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly drifted out from the pages, his voice aged and weary, 'you've done well. But the road ahead... will be harder than any time before. Remember, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets never truly lets anyone win against it.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji nodded slightly, yet his gaze grew ever more resolute. 'I know.' His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering determination, 'But this time, I won't lose.' He slowly raised his head, gazing at the horizon dyed red by the setting sun, his smile growing ever deeper—that was a player's smile, the composure of one who calculates without miss."

"The gears of fate have already begun to turn, and the curtain on the era of chaos is slowly rising. Chen Ji stands at the threshold of a new epoch, behind him the chess game he personally arranged, before him an even more perilous future. The prophecy on the Tianji Record's final page hangs like a sword above his head, constantly reminding him—the final trial approaches."

But he is no longer the bulliedtrash杂役 of the past. He is Chen Ji, the inheritor of the Tianji Record, a madman who dares to play against Heaven. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Han Lie... these people who were once his enemies or friends now stand by his side. Together, they will step into the endless river called "Destiny," pursuing that faint glimmer of victorious dawn.
